title: How the running_total state leak produces a wrong second report

stops.say: The first report totalled [1, 2, 3] = 6, which is correct. We are about to run the second report over the disjoint inputs [10, 20], which should total 30.

This is the mechanism. `seen` is a mutable DEFAULT argument, created once at definition time and shared by every call. On the second report's first call it will already carry the first report's values -- here on the very first call it holds [1].

And the consequence: second is 36, not the 30 that [10, 20] should total. The shared `seen` leaked the first report's numbers into the second. The fix is a per-call default: `def running_total(value, seen=None)` then `seen = seen or []`.
